no.yes: &It looks like one of the refugee center mutants is here.

truefalsetext.true: Hey never thought I'd find you here!

concatenate.yes: Hey! Yeah, I show up here every now and then.  Mostly to trade rumors, like everyone else.  In fact, I'm waiting for another survivor to show up and finish a deal we had.
concatenate.no: Yeah, waiting for another scavenger to show up.  Not feeling very confident about it now.

concatenate.yes: Oh, but you are one of the regulars here, right?  Maybe you know him?  At least enough to help me find him.

responses.text: I suppose.  Do you know the guys name?  Or at least how he looks like?

truefalsetext.true: I don't think so, besides, he probably got eaten by something.

dynamic_line: Made a deal with one of your guys, Thomas, but he never showed up.  Its about the sixth time we meet for trade, so I don't think he just got cold feet.  Was hoping he might show here eventually, but I guess not.

responses.text: Actually,  I think had a drink with him once, does lab raids while not in contract with Hub.  Might as well check he isn't dead now.
Not really.  Andrew!  You know of this guy?

dynamic_line:
Hey don't just go around telling everyone about my problems!"  she eyes you while pulling her cap even lower against her head.  She has basically melted into her stool by the time Andrew arrives.

<color_light_cyan>Andrew, Bartender</color>
"Does sound familiar.  If you are going to vouch for whatever this is, I know he holds up in an old cabin not that far from here.

responses.text: Thanks Andrew, I'll see what I can do.
Well theres your guy.  Good luck.

dynamic_line: Well, I really dont know Thomas well enough to just show up at his place unannounced.  Would you mind tagging along for this?  I'll pay for sure.

responses.text: Eh, not really looking for work right now.

dynamic_line.yes: Uh well." She looks around, worried about the prospect of being overheard.  "He's got some sort of medicine for my thing."  She rapidly gestures towards her knit cap.  "Sure, I look normal-ish now, but it gets worse whenever there's one of those weird storms.  It gets really bad.
dynamic_line.no: Its some really important medicine.  I thought the Hub put up with your group because you were discreet.

responses.text: Oh so its like some weird werewolf thing?
Alright, lets get your whatever it is.

dynamic_line: Changed your mind about the cabin thing?

responses.text: Not yet, I need to finish something.

dynamic_line: Yes.  Please forget I said anything."  She sighs.  "Lets just get on the way.
